messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT DETECTED: edge-us-south POP reporting elevated packet loss on transit peer ISP-Delta (egress). Severity: P1. Pager: sam

sam: acked. I'm on call, joining now.

kevin: seeing ~12-18% packet loss from our synthetic health checks to edge-us-south, started ~2026-03-15T02:05Z. Error spike in production traces for small-text generation and embeddings.

maria: netops telemetry shows BGP update storms to ISP-Delta with frequent route withdraws on the egress facing interface. Interface counters show drops, tx errors tick up.

sam: okay, triage: impact scope? how many customers/regions?

kevin: short window: ~7% of requests to the region are failing, errors are mostly connection resets and 504s. Affected traffic is predominantly outbound to customers in APAC routed via that peer.

pablo-cs: support seeing a spike in tickets around 02:07Z, some customers report slow responses and timeouts. Notifying top customers now.

ops-bot: Runbook: EDGE-PEERING-DEGRADATION. Steps: 1) Confirm drop counters 2) Open ticket with peer 3) Shift traffic to alternate peers/POPs 4) Monitor. https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-peering-degradation

sam: confirming diagnostics: can someone paste the FRR/bird show route outputs?

maria: here's a snippet of BGP state and counters:
```
# show bgp neighbors isp-delta
Neighbor 203.0.113.45 up, 4 prefixes, 80/90 updates/min
Sent RSTs: 1200, Last reset: 00:03:12
If counter (eth2): tx_errors=980, rx_errors=0
```

kevin: traceroutes show asymmetric paths. Something's flapping on their egress.

sam: immediate mitigation: shift traffic off ISP-Delta -> prefer ISP-Gamma and ISP-Echo. We'll use prepending and localpref to steer for affected prefixes, and announce backup paths. Maria, can you push route-map changes?

maria: applying localpref bump for customer-facing prefixes to prefer ISP-Gamma and ISP-Echo, and adding AS-path prepending for announcements to ISP-Delta so they prefer alternative paths. Pushing now.

maria: commands applied:
```
route-map STEER-TO-GAMMA permit 10
 set local-preference 200
!
bgp neighbor 203.0.113.45 route-map PREPEND-TO-DELTA out
route-map PREPEND-TO-DELTA permit 10
 set as-path prepend 65001 65001 65001
```

sam: nice. ops-bot, can you start a traffic-shift job to throttle sessions toward ISP-Delta and re-balance across POPs?

ops-bot: Kicking traffic-shift job #TS-2105. Policies: 60% reduce egress to ISP-Delta over 2 minutes; reroute to ISP-Gamma/ISP-Echo and edge-us-west-2 as fallback. Monitor: 30s buckets.

kevin: after route changes + traffic-shift, packet loss down to 3-4% within 90s. Latency improved.

pablo-cs: posted interim status to affected customers: "We're seeing degraded connectivity through a transit peer. We've rerouted traffic and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a root cause once confirmed."

sam: created ticket with ISP-Delta (ref: ISP-DELTA-2105004321). They acknowledged and investigating fabric on their side — reported partial mitigation on their uplinks.

maria: still seeing sporadic updates from the neighbor; counters stable but occasional withdraws. Keeping prepends for now.

kevin: traffic normalized for most queries; error rate down from 7% to <0.5% in the last 5m. We'll keep monitoring for 30 minutes.

chris: I'm taking the on-call handoff in 20m. Sam, any outstanding actions I should own?

sam: handoff: 1) keep prepends/live preferences in place until ISP confirms root cause & stable; 2) monitor synthetic checks for edge-us-south for next 60m; 3) if withdraws return, escalate to external comms + consider failover to edge-us-west-2 for entire POP.

chris: got it. I'll watch and update.

ops-bot: NOTE: automated rollback scheduled in 2 hours unless ticket updated. To cancel rollback, comment `ops-bot cancel-rollback TS-2105`.

pablo-cs: CS update: notified top 5 customers with potential impact, offered dedicated callbacks. No major escalations so far.

maria: ISP-Delta replied: "We see microbursts on peering fabric causing queue drops, applying microcode fix rolling now. Monitoring will take ~15-30m."

kevin: continuing telemetry: connections stable, some small spikes in retransmits but within tolerance.

chris: starting 30m watch window. If anything >1% errors reappears for >3 consecutive minutes, I'll escalate.

sam: thanks team. I'll open postmortem stub and tag netops/eng-sre/ps for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated. Severity -> P2. Ticket ISP-DELTA-2105004321 open. Postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2105004321

pablo-cs: will send customer follow-up once postmortem has initial timeline.

chris: closing loop: packet loss returned to baseline after ISP microcode roll. Removing prepends in 45m once stable for full hour.

sam: resolved for now. Great job everyone. :thumbsup:
